    The split form of a positive filtered deformation (Lemma 6.4, as used in Proposition 6.5) #

    positive-deformations.tex: "The resulting identification of B with Λ as filtered vector spaces induces the prescribed identification gr B = Λ, and the multiplication of B becomes μ₀ + Σ_{q>0} μ_q, where μ₀ is the multiplication of Λ and each μ_q raises internal degree by q, […] and vanishes when an input belongs to S."

    From a splitting φ : Λ ≅ B (Split, given by PosFiltration.exists_split) the transported product a ⋆ b = φ⁻¹(φa φb) decomposes into homogeneous parts μ_q (Split.μ), which form a positive deformation in split form (Split.posDef) with total product ⋆ (Split.tot_eq_star).

    source
    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.Split {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type w} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (P : PosFiltration G B) :
    Type (max v w)

    A splitting of a positive filtered deformation (Lemma 6.4): a linear isomorphism φ : Λ ≅ B preserving 1, mapping Λ_{≥d} onto F^d, with leading term the identity.

    • φ : Λ ≃ₗ[k] B
    • one : self.φ 1 = 1
    • σφ (d : ℕ) (a : Λ) : G.IsHom d a → (P.σ d) (self.φ a) = a
    • F_eq (d : ℕ) : Submodule.map (↑self.φ) (G.geSub d) = P.F d

                  Filtered lifts of graded modules #

                  source
                  structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.FLift {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type w} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (P : PosFiltration G B) {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (h1 : G.IsHom 0 1) (MM : GExt.GMod (GExt.GAlg.ofLen G h1) M) :
                  Type (max u_1 w)

                  A filtered lift of M to B with associated graded module M (positive-deformations.tex): a right B-action on the graded space M such that F^d B raises internal degree by at least d, with leading term the action of Λ through σ_d.

                  • act : M →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] M
                  • mul (m : M) (x y : B) : (self.act ((self.act m) x)) y = (self.act m) (x * y)
                  • one (m : M) : (self.act m) 1 = m
                  • filt (d : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (m : M) (x : B) : x ∈ P.F d → MM.gr.IsHom p m → ∀ e < p + ↑d, (MM.gr.proj e) ((self.act m) x) = 0
                  • lead (d : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (m : M) (x : B) : x ∈ P.F d → MM.gr.IsHom p m → (MM.gr.proj (p + ↑d)) ((self.act m) x) = (MM.act m) ((P.σ d) x)
